stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same time from two points 351 km apart and travel towards each other at 56 km/h and 27 km/h respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Relative speed (approaching) $= 56 + 27 = 83$ km/h. Time to meet $= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{relative speed}} = \dfrac{351}{83} = 4.23$ hours.
